headline: 3 detained after 13-year-old boy found dead in Comilla
summary: Ishayat Shahriyar Apratim, the son of a Comilla University teacher, went missing after leaving home to take photos with friends.
details: Ishayat Shahriyar Apratim, a seventh-grade student at Comilla Border Guard School, was found dead on a hill behind Magic Paradise Park near Comilla University on Saturday.

The boy had left home on Friday afternoon, taking his mother's iPhone to take photos with friends at Shalbon Bihar. When he failed to return by evening, his mother filed a general diary with the Comilla Sadar South Police Station.
Following the discovery of the body, police used CCTV footage to identify and detain three suspects: a young man named Tuhin, and subsequently Fahim and Anas.

The autopsy was completed on Saturday night, and the body was handed over to the family. Two funeral prayers will be held on Sunday, one at the university campus and another at the Gandhamati Eidgah field.
Comilla University has declared general mourning. Students and family members have expressed deep grief and demanded justice for the young boy.
caption:
A 13-year-old boy, the son of a university teacher, was found dead after going missing in Comilla.

Ishayat Shahriyar Apratim, a seventh-grade student at Comilla Border Guard School, was found dead on a hill behind Magic Paradise Park near Comilla University on Saturday.

The boy had left home on Friday afternoon, taking his mother's iPhone to take photos with friends at Shalbon Bihar. When he failed to return by evening, his mother filed a general diary with the Comilla Sadar South Police Station.

Following the discovery of the body, police used CCTV footage to identify and detain three suspects: a young man named Tuhin, and subsequently Fahim and Anas.

The autopsy was completed on Saturday night, and the body was handed over to the family. Two funeral prayers will be held on Sunday, one at the university campus and another at the Gandhamati Eidgah field.

Comilla University has declared general mourning. Students and family members have expressed deep grief and demanded justice for the young boy.

headline_marked: [[Three buses set on fire]] across Dhaka
headline: Three buses set on fire across Dhaka
summary: Two buses caught fire while moving in Mirpur, and another was set ablaze in Badda, causing chaos on the city's roads.
details: Three buses were set on fire in different parts of Dhaka, including Mirpur and Badda, causing significant disruption to traffic and public safety.
In Mirpur, two buses caught fire while they were in motion, forcing passengers to evacuate quickly to avoid injury.
A third bus was set on fire in the Badda area, adding to the series of incidents that occurred across the city.
Firefighters and emergency services responded to the scenes to bring the flames under control and prevent the fire from spreading to nearby vehicles or structures.
Authorities are investigating the cause of the fires to determine if they were accidental or intentional acts of arson.

Firefighters and emergency services responded to the scenes to bring the flames under control and prevent the fire from spreading to nearby vehicles or structures.

Authorities are investigating the cause of the fires to determine if they were accidental or intentional acts of arson.
